EC1: Malignancy [OR] and other significant medical conditions that will impact follow up within this program.
EC2: Those less than 18 years of age.
EC3: Concomitant interstitial lung disease [OR], sarcoidosis [OR], other significant lung disease.
EC4: Those who have had a transplant.
EC6: Unable to make appointments (every three to six months over 2 years).
EC7: Those residing in another country or planned absence for more than one month.
